decisions.reason: The existing message-89 MODIFY already captures the approved 50A supply, higher-power PWM controllers, and reserve-capacity requirement; no additional candidate-state change is necessary.
Approval of the BOM and its component selections does not change the requirement to provide the prototype system layout in CAD.
The approved controller and adapter selections do not alter the current mixing, frothing, whisk, or positioning acceptance criteria.
The source approves the BOM but does not change the requirement or specifications for the basic wiring-plan deliverable.
Selecting higher-power electrical components does not change the established splash target or permitted mitigation methods.
The BOM approval does not alter bowl removal, swapping, or clearance behavior.
Approval of a 50A AC/DC adapter does not replace or modify the client-confirmed standard 120V wall-outlet power source.
The approved electrical and compatibility selections do not change bowl capacity, depth, geometry, or enclosure-size constraints.
General component compatibility and BOM approval do not modify the required leak-free spout sealing behavior.
Confirmation that listed mechanical components are compatible does not change the unit's stability or vibration-control requirements.
The BOM approval does not change whisk removability, tool-free preference, or bowl-clearance behavior.
Higher-power PWM controller selection supports implementation but does not change the approved 0-to-3000-RPM range or intended speed modes.
